entities.name: Luis Amigó Ferrer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José María Amigó Ferrer was a Spanish Roman Catholic who served as the Bishop of Segorbe. He was also a professed member of the Order of Friars Minor - also known as the Capuchin order — and was also the founder of two religious orders: the Capuchin Tertiary Fathers and Brothers of Our Lady of Sorrows on 12 April 1889, and the Capuchin Tertiary Sisters of the Holy Family. He later assumed the name of "Luis from Masamagrell".
